schema_sql.title_version:
CREATE TABLE title_version(
            pk TEXT NOT NULL, raw_hash BLOB NOT NULL, raw BLOB NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(pk, raw_hash)) WITHOUT ROWID
schema_sql.title_observation:
CREATE TABLE title_observation(
            snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, pk TEXT NOT NULL, raw_hash BLOB NOT NULL,
            column_count INTEGER NOT NULL, identity_status TEXT NOT NULL, pnu TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(snapshot, pk)) WITHOUT ROWID
schema_sql.summary_version:
CREATE TABLE summary_version(
            pk TEXT NOT NULL, raw_hash BLOB NOT NULL, raw BLOB NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(pk, raw_hash)) WITHOUT ROWID
schema_sql.summary_observation:
CREATE TABLE summary_observation(
            snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, pk TEXT NOT NULL, raw_hash BLOB NOT NULL,
            column_count INTEGER NOT NULL, identity_status TEXT NOT NULL, pnu TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(snapshot, pk)) WITHOUT ROWID
schema_sql.source_file:
CREATE TABLE source_file(
        kind TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, file TEXT NOT NULL, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
        sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, rows INTEGER NOT NULL, loaded_rows INTEGER NOT NULL,
        scope TEXT NOT NULL, stats TEXT NOT NULL, loaded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(kind, snapshot))
schema_sql.build_info: CREATE TABLE build_info(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)
schema_sql.title_observation_pnu: CREATE INDEX title_observation_pnu ON title_observation(pnu) WHERE pnu IS NOT NULL
schema_sql.summary_observation_pnu: CREATE INDEX summary_observation_pnu ON summary_observation(pnu) WHERE pnu IS NOT NULL
